content_zh:
方行来回翻看着这个面具，装作一副懵懂的样子道：“你们不会骗我吧？”
大耗子精脸一沉，喝道：“胡说八道，你已经选中法器，记录在案，反悔不得了！”
“那……你们刚才还说，若是不满意，可以拿回来再换的……”
方行张大了嘴巴，好像被他们几人吓到了的样子。
“换？倒也不是不可以，就看你到时候的表现了！”
大耗子精冷笑，眼露精光，冷笑不已。
也不是没人来换过，有很多在他们手上吃了大亏的弟子，都事后找上门来，百般哀求，自愿掏出了身上所有的好东西，来求他们允许自己换一件法器。
通过这个法门，他们也不知捞了多少好处。
他们在玉符上记上了“低阶法器”这一个含混的名字，除了确实不知道这面具名字的原因之外，也有准备着方行再找上门来时，好敲他竹杠的打算。
反正记录上写的就是低阶法器一件，大不了到时候再换一件低阶法器好了，而若是那些写明了法宝名称以及特点的，就不这么好操作了，毕竟道门也是有自己的规矩的。
“那好吧，就它了！”
方行像是下定了决心，把面具往怀里一塞，转头就出去了。
大耗子精与两个师弟面面相觑，忽然一起放声大笑。
“居然真的选了这么一个玩意，这小子还跟得了什么宝贝一样……”
“嘿嘿，得罪了咱们师兄弟，这小子还想得着好？做梦啊那是！”
“哼，等他回头想要再换一件法器时，看我皮不给他扒了的！”
一直等候在外面的胖道人见方行出来了，急忙迎了上来，要看他选了什么法器。
方行把面具递给了他，胖道人拿在手里翻来覆去的看，狐疑道：“这是什么玩意？”
这面具看上去显得有些旧，上面还有破损，看起来实在不像是什么好东西。
方行一把夺了回来：“你懂个屁，这绝对是好东西，走吧，领我去修行的地方看看！”

胖道人见他信心满满，也不再多说了，就在前面领路，向道门给安排的修行之地走去，一路走着，一边给方行介绍这道门里的景致，他在杂司监领职，处处跑腿，因此对这道门各处还是很了解的，虽然平时不大受人待见，但毕竟接触人多，各种小道消息也是随口就来。
“师弟你看，那个地方是女弟子们居住的清音谷，谷外有一方清潭，师妹们经常在里面沐浴，为防不良子偷窥，潭边被门中长老布了一道灵雾，常年封锁，不过这灵雾啊，也不是时时都有的，只要你有恒心，趴在那处山头上，十天半个月的，总有守得雾开的时候，曾经有一个师兄，就在那里看到了女弟子们沐浴，回来足足讲了半个月……”
“这一处青崖，那是松古长老讲道的地方，他老人家是咱们青云宗的传奇人物，法力深厚，却待人和善，我们这等外门弟子向他老人家请安，也会笑着回应的。松烟长老每年重阳都会在这里讲一次道，有的时候讲修炼上需要注意的事端，有的时候讲法术之理，来听的弟子们不知道有多少，上至真传，下至外门，都欲求一席而不得啊……”
“那一处，更了不得了，是专修丹法的弟子们修行的地方，叫作栖霞岭，因为常年丹雾弥漫，恒久不去，所以得名，那里面的弟子都不好惹，一个个架子大的惊人，谁让咱们这些普通弟子早晚都会有求于他们呢？不过啊，栖霞岭的弟子里多女子，师弟你长的也不难看，等到年龄再大些，师兄给你介绍一位，有了这样一位道侣，好处多多啊……”
往云隐峰脚下外门弟子居住的山谷里去的道路不近，足足走了两个多时辰，胖道人嘴巴竟然一直没停过，不过他了解的也确实多，小道消息加上道门规定，足足说了两个多时辰也没重样，方行为了尽快了解青云宗，也不打断他，耐着性子听，偶尔还配合一下。
而胖道人难得得到这样一个显摆的机会，说的就更高兴了，滔滔不绝。

content_en:
Fang Xing looked at the mask back and forth, pretending to be confused and said, "You won't lie to me, will you?"
The big rat's face sank and he shouted: "That's nonsense. You have already chosen the magic weapon and recorded it in the record. You can't regret it!"
"Then...you just said that if you are not satisfied, you can take it back and change it..."
Fang Xing opened his mouth wide, as if he was frightened by them.
"Change? It's not impossible, it just depends on your performance then!"
The big rat spirit sneered, his eyes flashed, and he sneered.
It’s not like no one came to replace it. Many disciples who suffered great losses at their hands came to the door afterwards, begged in every possible way, and voluntarily took out all the good things on their bodies to beg their permission to exchange for a magic weapon.
Through this method, they don't know how much benefit they have gained.
They wrote down the vague name "low-level magic weapon" on the jade talisman. In addition to not knowing the reason for the name of the mask, they were also prepared to rip off Fang Xing when he came to the door again.
Anyway, what is written in the record is a low-level magic weapon. At worst, it will be replaced by a low-level magic weapon. But if the name and characteristics of the magic weapon are written clearly, it will not be so easy to operate. After all, the Taoist sect also has its own rules.
"Okay then, that's it!"
Fang Xing seemed to have made up his mind, stuffed the mask into his arms, turned around and went out.
The big mouse spirit and his two junior brothers looked at each other and suddenly burst out laughing together.
"To actually choose such a thing, this kid is like a treasure..."
"Hehe, after offending our senior brothers, this kid still wants to get better? That's a dream!"
"Hmph, when he comes back and wants to change another magic weapon, I'll make sure he doesn't peel off my skin!"
The fat Taoist who had been waiting outside saw Fang Xing come out and hurriedly greeted him to see what magic weapon he had chosen.
Fang Xing handed him the mask. The fat Taoist turned it over in his hand and asked suspiciously, "What is this?"
This mask looks a bit old and has some damage on it. It doesn't really look like a good thing.
Fang Xing snatched it back: "You know what the hell, this is definitely a good thing. Let's go and take me to the place of practice!"
Seeing that he was full of confidence, the fat Taoist said no more. He led the way to the practice place arranged by the Taoist sect. Along the way, he introduced the scenery in the sect to Fang Xing. He was in charge of the Miscellaneous Supervisor and ran errands everywhere, so he knew all about the sect very well. Although he was not popular with others, he came into contact with many people after all, and all kinds of gossip came casually.
"Junior brother, look, that place is the Qingyin Valley where the female disciples live. There is a clear pool outside the valley. The junior sisters often bathe in it. In order to prevent the unscrupulous sons from peeping, the elders of the sect have placed a spiritual mist around the pool to block it all year round. But this spiritual mist, It doesn’t happen all the time. As long as you have perseverance and lie down on that mountain for ten days and a half, there will always be a time when the fog clears. There once was a senior brother who saw female disciples taking a bath there and came back and talked for half a month..."
"This green cliff is where Elder Songgu preaches. He is a legend of our Qingyun Sect. He has deep magical power but is kind to others. When we outer disciples greet him, we will respond with a smile. Elder Songyan Every year during the Double Ninth Festival, sermons are given here. Sometimes they talk about things that need to be paid attention to in cultivation, and sometimes they talk about the principles of magic. I don’t know how many disciples come to listen, from the true teachings to the outer sects, all of them want to have a seat..."
"That place is even more remarkable. It is a place where disciples who specialize in alchemy practice. It is called Qixialing. It is named because the alchemy mist is filled all the year round and it is difficult to go there for a long time. The disciples there are not easy to mess with. They all have amazing arrogance. Who told ordinary disciples like us to have trouble sooner or later?What about asking for help from them? However, there are many women among the disciples in Qixialing, and you are not ugly, junior brother. When you get older, senior brother will introduce you to a Taoist companion. Having such a Taoist companion will bring many benefits..."
The road to the valley where the outer sect disciples live at the foot of Yunyin Peak is not close. After walking for more than two hours, the fat Taoist didn't stop talking. However, he did know a lot. The gossip and the sect's rules kept talking for more than two hours without repeating the same thing. In order to understand Qingyun Sect as quickly as possible, Fang Xing did not interrupt him, listened patiently, and occasionally cooperated.
The fat Taoist rarely got such an opportunity to show off, so he was even more happy and talked endlessly.
